summary:
My name is Riya and I am 8 years old. I made a storybook about a little robot called Opportunity.
Opportunity went to Mars to explore and find out if there was water on Mars a long time ago. I learned how it moved, took pictures and got energy from the Sun.
I was surprised that it worked for almost 15 years! I felt sad when a big dust storm stopped it from working.

I drew and coloured all the pictures in my book. I wanted to make a book so other kids like me could learn about Opportunity and Mars.

My favourite thing about Opportunity is that it kept going and did not give up. I think Opportunity is a brave little robot, and we should never forget it!
details:
I love drawing, so I decided to make a storybook about Opportunity. I used A4 paper, pencils, coloured pencils and my imagination to make my book.

I told the story as if Opportunity was talking to us. I drew its journey to Mars, its robot parts, its discoveries and the big dust storm. I learned about Opportunity by looking at NASA's pictures,Videos and reading about its mission with my parent's help.

I wanted to make science easy and fun for little kids. Some children may find science books hard to read, but they can learn from pictures and simple stories.

I also wanted children to know that even though Opportunity stopped working, all the things it discovered are still useful to us.

I hope my book makes other kids curious about Mars, robots and space. Maybe some of them will grow up and build their own space robots one day!
